text_en: When Rachel saw that she bore Jacob no children, she envied her sister; and she said to Jacob, “Give me children, or I shall die! ”
text_cn: 辣黑耳见自己没有给雅各伯生子，就嫉妒姐姐，对雅各伯说：“你要给我孩子；不然，我就死啦！”

text_en: Jacob became very angry with Rachel and said, “Am I in the place of God, who has withheld from you the fruit of the womb? ”
text_cn: 雅各伯对辣黑耳生气说：“不肯使你怀孕的是天主，难道我能替他作主？”

text_en: Then she said, “Here is my maid Bilhah; go in to her, that she may bear upon my knees and that I too may have children through her. ”
text_cn: 辣黑耳回答说：“这里有我的婢女彼耳哈，你亲近她，叫她在我膝下生子，使我能由她得子。”

text_en: So she gave him her maid Bilhah as a wife; and Jacob went in to her.
text_cn: 辣黑耳就将自己的婢女彼耳哈给了雅各伯作妾；雅各伯亲近了她，

text_en: And Bilhah conceived and bore Jacob a son.
text_cn: 她遂怀孕，给雅各伯生了一子。

text_en: Then Rachel said, “God has judged me, and has also heard my voice and given me a son”; therefore she named him Dan.
text_cn: 辣黑耳就说：“天主对我公道，俯听了我的哀声，给了我一子。”为此给他起名叫丹。

text_en: Rachel’s maid Bilhah conceived again and bore Jacob a second son.
text_cn: 辣黑耳的婢女彼耳哈又怀孕，给雅各伯生了第二个儿子。

text_en: Then Rachel said, “With mighty wrestlings I have wrestled with my sister, and have prevailed”; so she named him Naphtali.
text_cn: 辣黑耳就说：“我以天大的力量与我姐姐相争，得到胜利了。”便给他起名叫纳斐塔里。

text_en: When Leah saw that she had ceased bearing children, she took her maid Zilpah and gave her to Jacob as a wife.
text_cn: 肋阿见自己停止生育，也将自己的婢女齐耳帕给了雅各伯作妾。

text_en: Then Leah’s maid Zilpah bore Jacob a son.
text_cn: 肋阿的婢女齐耳帕给雅各伯生了一子。

text_en: And Leah said, “Good fortune! ” so she named him Gad.
text_cn: 肋阿遂说：“好幸运！”就给他起名叫加得。

text_en: Leah’s maid Zilpah bore Jacob a second son.
text_cn: 肋阿的婢女齐耳帕给雅各伯又生了第二个儿子。

text_en: And Leah said, “Happy am I! For the women will call me happy”; so she named him Asher.
text_cn: 肋阿遂说：“我真有福！女人都要以为我有福。”就给他起名叫阿协尔。

text_en: In the days of wheat harvest Reuben went and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them to his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, “Please give me some of your son’s mandrakes. ”
text_cn: 到了割麦的时节，勒乌本出去，在田间寻得了一些曼陀罗，带回来给了他母亲肋阿。辣黑耳对肋阿说：“请你将你儿子得的曼陀罗给我一些。”

text_en: But she said to her, “Is it a small matter that you have taken away my husband? Would you take away my son’s mandrakes also? ” Rachel said, “Then he may lie with you tonight for your son’s mandrakes. ”
text_cn: 肋阿回答说：“你夺去了我的丈夫还不够；你还想夺去我儿的曼陀罗么？”辣黑耳说：“好吧！今夜就让他与你同睡，为交换你儿子的曼陀罗。”

text_en: When Jacob came from the field in the evening, Leah went out to meet him, and said, “You must come in to me; for I have hired you with my son’s mandrakes. ” So he lay with her that night.
text_cn: 到了晚上，雅各伯由田间回来，肋阿就跑出去迎接他说：“你该来我这里，因为我用我儿子的曼陀罗雇了你。”那夜雅各伯便与她同睡。

text_en: And God heeded Leah, and she conceived and bore Jacob a fifth son.
text_cn: 天主俯允了肋阿，她又怀孕，给雅各伯生了第五个儿子。

text_en: Leah said, “God has given me my hire because I gave my maid to my husband”; so she named him Issachar.
text_cn: 肋阿说：“天主给了我报酬，因为我将我的婢女给了我的丈夫。” 便给他起名叫依撒加尔。

text_en: And Leah conceived again, and she bore Jacob a sixth son.
text_cn: 肋阿又怀孕，给雅各伯生了第六个儿子。

text_en: Then Leah said, “God has endowed me with a good dowry; now my husband will honor me, because I have borne him six sons”; so she named him Zebulun.
text_cn: 肋阿说：“天主给了我一个很好的礼物；这一回我的丈夫要与我同居了，因为我给他生了六个儿子。”便给他起名叫则步隆。

text_en: Afterwards she bore a daughter, and named her Dinah.
text_cn: 后来她生了一个女儿，给她起名叫狄纳。

text_en: Then God remembered Rachel, and God heeded her and opened her womb.
text_cn: 天主想起了辣黑耳，垂允了她，开了她的子宫，

text_en: She conceived and bore a son, and said, “God has taken away my reproach”;
text_cn: 她遂怀孕，生了一个儿子，说：“天主拭去了我的耻辱。”

text_en: and she named him Joseph, saying, “May the Lord add to me another son! ”
text_cn: 她给他起名叫若瑟说：“愿上主再给我添子。”

text_en: When Rachel had borne Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, “Send me away, that I may go to my own home and country.
text_cn: 辣黑耳生了若瑟以后，雅各伯对拉班说：“请让我回到我的本乡故土！

text_en: Give me my wives and my children for whom I have served you, and let me go; for you know very well the service I have given you. ”
text_cn: 请你将我服事你所得的妻子儿女交给我，让我回去；你知道我怎样服事了你。”

text_en: But Laban said to him, “If you will allow me to say so, I have learned by divination that the Lord has blessed me because of you;
text_cn: 拉班对他说：“如果我在你眼中得宠，请你住下；我觉察出，上主祝福我，是为了你的原故。”

text_en: name your wages, and I will give it. ”
text_cn: 继而说：“请规定你的工价，我必付给你。”

text_en: Jacob said to him, “You yourself know how I have served you, and how your cattle have fared with me.
text_cn: 雅各伯对他说：“你知道，我是怎样服事了你；你的牲畜跟着我是怎样的情形。

text_en: For you had little before I came, and it has increased abundantly; and the Lord has blessed you wherever I turned. But now when shall I provide for my own household also? ”
text_cn: 我未来之前，你所有的是那么少，现在增加了那么多；我一来，上主就祝福了你。但是，我几时也能为我兴家立业呢？”

text_en: He said, “What shall I give you? ” Jacob said, “You shall not give me anything; if you will do this for me, I will again feed your flock and keep it:
text_cn: 拉班问说：“我该给你什么？”雅各伯答说：“你什么也不必给我，只要你应承我这件事，我就仍牧放照顾你的羊群：

text_en: let me pass through all your flock today, removing from it every speckled and spotted sheep and every black lamb, and the spotted and speckled among the goats; and such shall be my wages.
text_cn: 你今天走遍你的羊群，将其中凡有斑点或黑点的，即绵羊群中有黑色的，山羊群中有黑点或斑点的，都挑出来，当作我的工价。

text_en: So my honesty will answer for me later, when you come to look into my wages with you. Every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats and black among the lambs, if found with me, shall be counted stolen. ”
text_cn: 后来任何一天，你来察看我的工价时，我好对你证明我的公正。山羊中凡是没有斑点或黑点的，绵羊中凡是不黑的，都算是偷来的。”

text_en: Laban said, “Good! Let it be as you have said. ”
text_cn: 拉班回答说：“好，就照你的话办吧！”

text_en: But that day Laban removed the male goats that were striped and spotted, and all the female goats that were speckled and spotted, every one that had white on it, and every lamb that was black, and put them in charge of his sons;
text_cn: 当天拉班就将有条纹有斑点的公山羊，凡有白纹，或斑点和黑点的母山羊，并黑色的绵羊都挑出来，交在自己儿子们手中；

text_en: and he set a distance of three days’ journey between himself and Jacob, while Jacob was pasturing the rest of Laban’s flock.
text_cn: 又使雅各伯与自己相距三日的路程。雅各伯便牧放拉班其余的羊群。

text_en: Then Jacob took fresh rods of poplar and almond and plane, and peeled white streaks in them, exposing the white of the rods.
text_cn: 雅各伯拿了杨树、杏树和枫树的嫩枝，将皮剥成一条一条的白纹，使树枝的光白露出；

text_en: He set the rods that he had peeled in front of the flocks in the troughs, that is, the watering places, where the flocks came to drink. And since they bred when they came to drink,
text_cn: 然后将剥去皮的枝条，插在水沟和水漕里，羊群前来喝水时，正与羊群相对。羊群前来喝水时，就彼此相配。

text_en: the flocks bred in front of the rods, and so the flocks produced young that were striped, speckled, and spotted.
text_cn: 羊群对着枝条相配，就生出了有条纹，有斑点和黑点的小羊。

text_en: Jacob separated the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the striped and the completely black animals in the flock of Laban; and he put his own droves apart, and did not put them with Laban’s flock.
text_cn: 雅各伯将这些羔羊分开，将这些羊放在拉班羊群中有条纹和有黑点的羊前；这样他为自己另组羊群，不将它们放在拉班的羊群中。

text_en: Whenever the stronger of the flock were breeding, Jacob laid the rods in the troughs before the eyes of the flock, that they might breed among the rods,
text_cn: 到了肥壮的羊要配合时，雅各伯就将枝条插在水沟里，对着羊群的眼，使羊对着枝条彼此相配。

text_en: but for the feebler of the flock he did not lay them there; so the feebler were Laban’s, and the stronger Jacob’s.
text_cn: 当羊群瘦弱时，他就不插枝条：这样，瘦弱的都归拉班，肥壮的都归雅各伯。

text_en: Thus the man grew exceedingly rich, and had large flocks, and male and female slaves, and camels and donkeys.
text_cn: 为此这人越来越富，拥有许多羊群，婢女和奴仆，骆驼和驴子。
